rationale: The agent authenticated the user successfully before taking any action. They correctly handled the cancellation requests and provided information based on orders and items present in the user's account. The cancellation and return processes were carried out according to policy. The clarity of the follow-up regarding the user needing to contact a human agent for the address change was well articulated, adhering to policy. There is a slight uncertainty due to the inability to directly modify the address after the order was marked as modified, but the overall handling was appropriate.
